Name: Skrumps Color Grading - ReShade
Author: Skrumpelnissen
Description:
[center][b][size=6]~ Skrumps Color Grading — ReShade ~[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i][color=#ffff00][size=4]Mod managers not supported.[/size][/color][/i][/center]

[line]
[b][size=5]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]Custom color grading[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Sharpening for a bit crisper visuals[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Doesn't touch any core game files (fully reversible)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Simple one-click installer, no manual file copying[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Download and extract this mod's zip directly into your Stardew Valley install folder (same folder that contains "[color=#ffffff]Stardew Valley.exe[/color]")[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Run "ReShade Installer.bat"[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch the game and press "HOME" to toggle the ReShade overlay on/off[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Load the preset "Skrumps_Color_Grading.ini" in ReShade (it should be on by default though)[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=5]Notes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4]The installer is an unsigned ".bat" script, so your antivirus may flag it — this is expected for small unsigned tools, and the script is plain text you can open and read before running it.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]If you ever want to remove the mod, just delete opengl32.dll, ReShade.ini, Skrumps_Color_Grading.ini, and the reshade-shaders folder from your game directory.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[i][size=5]I highly recommend combining this with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]" mod for even better visuals! (see screenshots)[/size][/i]

Downloads.Description:
1. Extract the zip into your Stardew Valley install folder (NOT THE MOD FOLDER)
2. Run the installer

If you have any problems, msg me.
